summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) containing five Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns dated September 14-18, 2026, disclosing daily on-market share repurchases. Under the September 14 filing, the company repurchased 119,600 Class A ordinary shares at an average price of HKD 46.8271 per share, held as treasury shares, reducing issued shares ex-treasury to 1,721,194,457 (0.0069% of the prior balance) and raising treasury shares to 97,130,652. Repurchases were executed under Main Board Rule 13.25A; watch continued daily buyback cadence, aggregate spend, treasury-share overhang, and any cancellation intentions.
